Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.persistence

Class ArticleStorageAdapter

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.persistence.ArticleStorageAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
ArticleStoragePort
@Component public class ArticleStorageAdapter extends Object implements ArticleStoragePort
JPA-backed implementation of ArticleStoragePort.

Persists harvested NewsArticle domain records to the news_articles table via NewsArticleRepository. Deduplication is performed per-article using NewsArticleRepository.existsByUrl(String); any article whose URL already exists is silently skipped without error.

The domain NewsArticle record is converted to a NewsArticleEntity inside this adapter — the entity never leaves the infrastructure layer. The url field is stored as a String (the java.net.URI is converted via toString()).

      public void save(List<NewsArticle> articles)
      Persists the supplied articles, skipping any whose URL is already stored.

      Iterates the supplied list and checks each article's URL for an existing row before inserting. Duplicate URLs are skipped and logged at DEBUG level.

      Specified by:
      save in interface ArticleStoragePort
